nodes.label: Dev Release Workflow
nodes.definition: Forgejo CI workflow that auto-publishes dev-track builds on every push to the dev branch

nodes.label: Beta Release Workflow
nodes.definition: Forgejo CI workflow that auto-publishes beta-track builds on every push to the beta branch (frozen stabilization)

nodes.label: Stable Release Workflow
nodes.definition: Forgejo CI workflow triggered by v* tag push; cuts stable releases and uploads to GitHub

nodes.label: Main Branch
nodes.definition: Release branch, always tag-ready. Only moves forward via beta merge

nodes.label: Dev Branch
nodes.definition: Integration branch where all day-to-day work lands first. Auto-publishes dev builds on push

nodes.label: Beta Branch
nodes.definition: Frozen stabilization branch cut from dev periodically. Auto-publishes beta builds; only fix branches merged after freeze

nodes.label: Dev Track
nodes.definition: Bleeding edge release track; distributed from dev branch via dl.breadway.dev/dev

nodes.label: Beta Track
nodes.definition: Current stabilization freeze track; distributed from beta branch via dl.breadway.dev/beta

nodes.label: Stable Track
nodes.definition: Last tagged release track; distributed from main branch via dl.breadway.dev

nodes.label: Release Cycle
nodes.definition: Three-phase release workflow: 1 week dev stability, then beta cut + 1 month stabilization, then merge to main + tag for stable release

nodes.label: Bakery Package Manager
nodes.definition: Bread ecosystem package manager; users manage install tracks via 'bakery track set' / 'bakery update --all'

nodes.label: dl.breadway.dev
nodes.definition: Breadway package distribution server hosting dev/beta/stable builds and signed index.json

nodes.label: breadcastd Daemon
nodes.definition: Background daemon that discovers Cast devices on LAN, owns screen-capture/encode/serve pipeline and live Cast V2 session

nodes.label: breadcast UI
nodes.definition: GTK4 Layer Shell popup for picking a device and starting/stopping a cast

nodes.label: breadcast-core Library
nodes.definition: Core Rust library providing device discovery example

nodes.label: Cast Protocol
nodes.definition: Cast/Chromecast discovery protocol via mDNS; device_id is protocol-specific

nodes.label: DLNA Protocol
nodes.definition: DLNA/UPnP media renderer discovery via SSDP; device_id is protocol-specific (description URL)

nodes.label: CASTV2 Protocol
nodes.definition: Cast V2 control protocol implementation; uses TLS control channel and arbitrary namespace messaging

nodes.label: Cast Streaming
nodes.definition: Cast Streaming sender protocol: RTP/RTCP send + OFFER/ANSWER negotiation + AES frame encryption

nodes.label: Device Discovered Event
nodes.definition: bread.cast.device_found event fired when Chromecast/Google TV or DLNA renderer discovered/re-resolved on LAN; fires on every re-resolution

nodes.label: Mirroring Started Event
nodes.definition: bread.cast.mirroring_started event fired when mirroring session successfully starts via command, IPC, or popup

nodes.label: Mirroring Stopped Event
nodes.definition: bread.cast.mirroring_stopped event fired when session ends (explicit stop or unprompted receiver disconnect)

nodes.label: Mirroring Failed Event
nodes.definition: bread.cast.mirroring_failed event fired when start attempt fails before session established

nodes.label: Cast Start Command
nodes.definition: bread.command.cast.start command; fire-and-forget starts mirroring to given device (outcome via mirroring_started/failed events)

nodes.label: Cast Stop Command
nodes.definition: bread.command.cast.stop command; stops active mirroring session if any

nodes.label: Breadd Integration
nodes.definition: breadcastd publishes into shared bread automation fabric (bread.cast.*/bread.command.cast.*) when breadd present; fails gracefully without it

nodes.label: Bread Automation Fabric
nodes.definition: Shared bread ecosystem event/command bus; optional for breadcast, provides device discovery events and command reception

nodes.label: bread_client Transport
nodes.definition: bread-utils module (feature flag bread-client) handling IPC to bread automation fabric; linked directly by breadcastd

nodes.label: Screen Mirroring Pipeline
nodes.definition: Portal-based screen capture → GPU-accelerated encode → HLS → local HTTP server pipeline (not fully built in current version)

nodes.label: GStreamer
nodes.definition: Media framework for encoding pipeline; requires gst-plugin-pipewire, gst-plugins-bad (VA-API), gst-plugin-hlssink3

nodes.label: Hyprland
nodes.definition: Wayland compositor target; requires Layer Shell + xdg-desktop-portal ScreenCast interface

nodes.label: Wayland
nodes.definition: Display server protocol required for breadcast

nodes.label: XDG Desktop Portal
nodes.definition: XDG Desktop Portal with ScreenCast interface for secure screen capture

nodes.label: GTK4
nodes.definition: GTK 4.12+ UI toolkit for breadcast popup

nodes.label: gtk4-layer-shell
nodes.definition: Layer Shell protocol binding for GTK4; required for breadcast popup

nodes.label: Systemd User Service
nodes.definition: breadcastd.service unit file in contrib/ for persistent daemon management

nodes.label: Hyprland Keybind
nodes.definition: Super+C keybind launches breadcast popup; stock conf vs BOS Lua+JSON config differences

nodes.label: Bread Theme
nodes.definition: Shared bread ecosystem color palette; breadcast UI will inherit theme once built

nodes.label: OpenScreen Vendor
nodes.definition: Chromium OpenScreen pruned subset (BSD-3-Clause); Cast Streaming sender data path (RTP/RTCP, OFFER/ANSWER, AES encryption)

nodes.label: breadcast-caststream-sys
nodes.definition: Rust FFI wrapper for Cast Streaming sender path; uses cc crate to compile vendored OpenScreen C++

nodes.label: rust_cast Vendor
nodes.definition: azasypkin/rust-cast 0.21.0 (MIT licensed) vendored via [patch.crates-io]; patched with generic point-to-point CASTV2 namespace send

nodes.label: CastDevice::send_message
nodes.definition: Custom method patch added to rust_cast; generic point-to-point send on arbitrary CASTV2 namespace with caller-supplied destination

nodes.label: WebRTC Namespace
nodes.definition: urn:x-cast:com.google.cast.webrtc namespace for OFFER/ANSWER exchange with Cast receiver app

nodes.label: mDNS Discovery
nodes.definition: Multicast DNS discovery for Chromecast/Google TV devices on LAN

nodes.label: SSDP Discovery
nodes.definition: Simple Service Discovery Protocol for finding DLNA/UPnP media renderers on LAN

nodes.label: Daemon Actor Pattern
nodes.definition: breadcastd uses actor pattern with single 'active session' notion across all control surfaces (command, IPC, popup)

nodes.label: Minisign
nodes.definition: Cryptographic signature tool for signing bakery index.json; secret stored as CI variable

nodes.label: Semantic Versioning
nodes.definition: Version scheme: X.Y.Z for stable, X.Y.Z-dev.<timestamp>+<sha> for dev, X.Y.Z-beta.<timestamp>+<sha> for beta; auto-computed from latest tag

nodes.label: Version Sorting
nodes.definition: Dev/beta versions always sort newer than stable via timestamp suffix, ensuring bakery accepts them over existing installs

nodes.label: Self-Hosted Runner
nodes.definition: Forgejo CI uses self-hosted hestia runner for all builds (not cloud CI)

nodes.label: GitHub Release
nodes.definition: GitHub mirror destination for stable releases; breadcast binaries uploaded via gh CLI with GH_RELEASE_TOKEN

nodes.label: Bread Ecosystem
nodes.definition: Multi-project ecosystem with shared release channel policy and automation; breadcast follows same workflow as other products

nodes.label: Feature Branch
nodes.definition: Short-lived branch (feature/<name> or fix/<issue>) branched from dev; merged back to dev via PR when ready
